name: Spike Thrower

source.title: Pathfinder Adventure: Crown of the Kobold King

disable: DC 18 Thievery check to jam the gears and prevent the trap from being activated

items.name: Throw Spikes
items.text:
Trigger This trap must be manually activated by a creature adjacent to the southwest gear stack;

Effect The spike thrower makes a ranged attack against each creature in the central part of area F2.

text: Slats in the ceiling open and pepper the chamber below with long, metal spikes fired from the spring-loaded tubes.
